mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(bsp.period_end_balance,0) from book_subject_period bsp LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bs.subject_id = bsp.subject_id where bs.code = #{subjectCode} and bsp.year_period = #{currentPeriod} and bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bsp.del_flag = '0'

SELECT IFNULL(bsp.period_end_balance,0) from book_subject_period bsp LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bs.subject_id = bsp.subject_id where bs.code = #{subjectCode} and bsp.year_period = #{lastYearPeriod} and bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bsp.del_flag = '0'
SELECT IF(balance_direction='DEBIT',IFNULL(debit,0),IFNULL(credit,0)) from book_subject where code = #{subjectCode} and book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT', IF(IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0)=0,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0),IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0)), IF(IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0)=0,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0),IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0)) ) FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_carryover bc ON bv.type_class_id = bc.carryover_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',#{subjectCode} ,'%') and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',#{subjectCode} ,'%') and bc.code = 'carryForward'
and bv.year_period <= #{endPeriod} and YEAR(year_period) = YEAR(#{endPeriod})
select * from book_report_cash where book_id = #{bookId} and cash_name = '四、净利润（净亏损以“-”号填列）'
select * from book_report_cash where book_id = #{bookId} and row_num = #{rowNum}
